overviewHtml:
Teams that share a Dynatrace environment need to know who uses what and what it costs. This dashboard gives the transparency to show costs back to teams and find optimization opportunities.

What you get

  • Total usage and costs for any selected period
  • Service fees applied on top of Dynatrace rate cards
  • Cost trends over time
  • Drill-down by cost center or product
  • Tracing of each usage item back to its source
prereqsHtml:
Before you begin, ensure you have:

  • A Dynatrace environment with access to the Dashboards app.
  • Appropriate permissions to import and edit dashboards.
  • Appropriate permissions to view System Events.
  • DPS Cost Allocation properly set up.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Cost Allocation configured and permission to view system events.

  1. Import the dashboard JSON into the Dashboards app
  2. Choose the dashboard variant and rate card settings you need
  3. Select a period and explore costs by cost center or product
